messages:

Cc: contracts@mirhealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace private offer — initial MAP and billing questions

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week. MiraHealth is ready to move toward a private offer (AWS Marketplace) but we need to align on the mutual action plan and the invoice/billing path for our internal procurement.

Attached is the MAP draft from our side ("MiraHealth_MAP_v1.pdf"). A few key constraints:
- Finance requires invoice-to: MiraHealth Inc., AP contact: contracts@mirhealth.com
- We need to confirm whether Redwood can accept invoices via our cloud marketplace purchase (AWS Private Offer) or whether we need a vendor invoice (net 30).
- Expected PO window: we plan to issue a PO by 2028-03-10 assuming legal review completes this month.

Can you outline the acceptance gates you need (tech sign-off, SLA, billing confirmation) and whether there are staged acceptance milestones we should include in the MAP? Also please confirm any documents you need from our side for SOC 2 / data residency.

Thanks — Nadia

---

MiraHealth

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nadia Perez <nadia.perez@mirhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, contracts@mirhealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Jan 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer — initial MAP and billing questions

Hi Nadia — great to hear you're ready to move forward. I've sketched a pragmatic MAP and acceptance runbook below and attached our acceptance checklist for your review ("redwood_mpa_acceptance_checklist.xlsx").

High-level MAP (proposed):
1) Technical evaluation (1–2 weeks) — staging access, test corpus, basic SLA smoke tests
2) Legal & procurement (concurrent) — private offer terms, PO template review
3) Acceptance gate 1 (tech sign-off) — functional acceptance on dev/staging
4) Acceptance gate 2 (billing readiness) — confirm marketplace invoice flow or vendor invoice path
5) PO issuance & activation — customer issues PO, we activate private offer entitlement

We can shorten the tech eval if you provide a small sample dataset and a primary acceptance owner. For billing: Redwood supports both AWS Private Offer invoicing (we receive payment via marketplace and invoice your AP indirectly) and direct vendor billing (we can issue an invoice to MiraHealth). Each has tradeoffs: marketplace route simplifies procurement but ties billing to the marketplace timeline; vendor invoice gives you a direct vendor relationship and standard net terms.

Action items for MiraHealth:
- Confirm preferred billing path (Marketplace PO vs. Vendor invoice) and AP contact (you listed contracts@mirhealth.com).
- Provide any compliance evidence requests (SOC 2 report request form or contact for security questionnaire).

I've attached the acceptance checklist and a lightly redlined MAP template. Once you confirm billing preference we'll align legal and finance.

Best,
Irene
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_mpa_acceptance_checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 48 KB)]

Irene / Nadia,

- If activation cannot be guaranteed, we will request a vendor invoice path (net 30).
- Legal needs the private offer terms on file; attaching our PO template for your legal to review.

Our tentative timeline:
- Internal legal review complete by 2028-02-15
- PO issued by 2028-03-10 (target)

Attaching PO template: MiraHealth_PO_template.xlsx

Let us know whether Redwood can provide the 48-hour activation commitment on AWS Private Offer or if vendor invoice is the default.

Regards,
